A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Falleen''' was present during [[Vareesa Enan]]'s [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] travel from [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] to [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] during the years of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Vareesa noted that he was very arrogant and everyone seemed to avoid him.
